name: summarize-pull-request
description: Reads a pull request diff, groups the changes by intent and produces a reviewer-facing summary with risks, test coverage notes and a suggested review order.
body:
# Summarize pull request

Use this skill when a reviewer needs a fast, structured read of a large diff.

## Steps

1. Collect the diff and the linked issue.
2. Group hunks by intent: behaviour, refactor, tests, docs.
3. Call out risky hunks and missing tests.
4. Propose a review order, cheapest signal first.

## Output

A markdown summary with sections: Intent, Risk, Tests, Review order.

name: an-extremely-long-skill-name-that-should-wrap-or-truncate-in-every-layout-mode
